title: Paul Cézanne, Flowers in a Rococo Vase, 500 CFA francs, Flowers in Painting Collection
descriptionPlain: Description Paul Cézanne focused on precision and the quiet discipline of observation. In this composition, every petal and every shade of blue is arranged with deliberate clarity. The realistic rendering of the flowers reveals the subtle relationships between colours that defined his style. The coin faithfully preserves these qualities, while the magnifying lens brings out fine tonal transitions and the texture of each brushstroke. It is an elegant choice for those who value purity of form and Cézanne’s mastery of detail.
